decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the 12-ounce cup size and 5.5-inch clearance height; edge-to-edge platform alignment adds no further cup-clearance state.
The source sets the separate platform's height and footprint alignment but does not change the machine enclosure's compactness, side profile, or bowl-well form.
Specifying platform height and edge-to-edge fit does not alter the existing requirement for a stable, vibration-resistant structure.
The source contains no color or font decision and therefore leaves the established machine and platform color scheme unchanged.
The source discusses platform dimensions and machine fit, not placard text, faces, or placement.
The platform is sized to provide clearance beneath the existing spouts; the source does not change their geometry, orientation, location, or fabrication style.
The stated 5.5-inch height applies to the external platform and does not affect whisk-head selection or positioning.
Platform height and footprint alignment do not modify bowl capacity, bowl form, or the existing size preference.
The source provides physical clearance beneath the spouts but does not change solenoid actuation, valve behavior, or dispensing isolation.
The source does not add, remove, or alter any DJ-turntable visual detail.
The platform dimension decision does not change any food-contact material requirement.
The source concerns cup clearance and platform fit and does not modify splash-control targets, methods, or high-speed behavior.
